findings.evidence: Lines 227 and 236: `simpa only [Hom.id_mapE, id_eq] using (Hom.id Γ).map_cycleLattice_le hO` and `... map_modTwoCycleSpace_le hO`. Contrast `hE` at lines 211–214, which proves the equation with `Subtype.ext`.
findings.fix: Prove both lemmas from `incidenceBoundary_mapDomain_inclusion`: `intro y hy; obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hy; rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, incidenceBoundary_mapDomain_inclusion]; exact hc`. Better still, state one generic-`R` kernel lemma and specialise it to ℤ and ZMod 2, as the `Hom.*` lemmas already do.
findings.issue: `map_cycleLattice_le_of_subset` (and `map_modTwoCycleSpace_le_of_subset` at line 236) ends with `simpa only [Hom.id_mapE, id_eq] using (Hom.id Γ).map_cycleLattice_le hO`. After that simp, the hypothesis mentions `fun e => ⟨e.1, _⟩` while the goal mentions `Set.inclusion h`, and `simpa` only matches them because `Set.inclusion` unfolds definitionally to that function. `incidenceBoundary_mapDomain_inclusion` proves this equation explicitly as `hE`, so these two lemmas are inconsistent with it.

findings.evidence: The same three-line `hO` block appears at lines 208–210, 224–226 and 233–235.
findings.fix: Remove the copies. Either factor this step out as a single private lemma, or derive the two `_le_of_subset` lemmas from `incidenceBoundary_mapDomain_inclusion` as in the previous finding, so `hO` is built only once.
findings.issue: The same `have hO : Set.MapsTo (Hom.id Γ).mapE O O' := by intro e he; simpa only [Hom.id_mapE, id_eq] using h he` is repeated in `incidenceBoundary_mapDomain_inclusion` (line 208), `map_cycleLattice_le_of_subset` (line 224) and `map_modTwoCycleSpace_le_of_subset` (line 233).

summary: Two subset-inclusion lemmas close their goals by relying on an undocumented definitional equality between the identity-morphism dart map and `Set.inclusion h`. The same `Set.MapsTo (Hom.id Γ).mapE O O'` proof is copied into three proofs.
